hero.headline: Your move in Munich — planned, packed, delivered. Damage-free, guaranteed.
hero.subheadline: Private and corporate moves from one provider: packing, furniture assembly, transport and setup — with full value compensation if anything is damaged.

items.title: Private moves
items.body: From studio apartments to family homes — on schedule, careful, no stress for you.

items.title: Corporate moves
items.body: Offices, practices and warehouses — scheduled outside your business hours, minimal downtime.

items.title: Packing
items.body: Professional packing materials, or full-service packing by our team on request.

items.title: Assembly & disassembly
items.body: Furniture is professionally disassembled, transported, and reassembled on-site.

items.title: Transport
items.body: Our own fleet, experienced crews, insured transport.

items.title: Add-ons
items.body: No-parking zones, furniture lift, temporary storage on request.

guarantee.badge: Damage-free guarantee · Full value compensation if damaged
guarantee.headline: The Damage-Free Guarantee
guarantee.lead: We don't just promise care — we guarantee the outcome: if anything is damaged during your move, we pay full value compensation.

steps.title: Documentation before the move
steps.body: Our team records the condition of valuable and delicate items before transport.

steps.title: Careful transport
steps.body: Trained staff, suitable packing materials, secured loading.

steps.title: Documentation after the move
steps.body: Condition is checked and recorded together with you at the destination.

steps.title: Reporting a claim
steps.body: If something is damaged regardless, let us know — simply, with a photo and short description.

steps.title: Full value compensation
steps.body: After review, we reimburse the full value of the damaged item — no fine-print games.

items.question: What happens if something is damaged during my move?
items.answer: Report the damage to us with a photo and short description. Since we document condition before and after the move, review is fast and fair — you receive full value compensation.

items.question: How far in advance should I book my move?
items.answer: For private moves we recommend 2–3 weeks' notice; for corporate moves ideally 4–6 weeks, so we can plan outside your business hours. Short-notice dates are available on request.

items.question: Do you also handle packing?
items.answer: Yes — on request we pack your entire household professionally, or assist selectively with delicate items.

items.question: What does a move cost?
items.answer: Price depends on scope, distance and add-ons. Ask our chat assistant for an initial estimate, or request a callback.

items.question: Is my property insured during transport?
items.answer: Yes. In addition to statutory transport insurance, our damage-free guarantee applies with full value compensation.
